def create_single_weather(df, rename_dc):
    """Create an oemof weather object for the given geometry"""
    # Create a weather object
    weather = oemof.solph.custom.Weather(
        location=df.index[0],
        latitude=df.latitude[0],
        longitude=df.longitude[0],
        altitude=df.altitude[0],
        tz=df.tz[0],
        start=df.index[0],
        end=df.index[-1],
        weather_file=df.weather_file[0],
        temp_unit='degC',
        pressure_unit='Pa',
        wind_unit='m/s',
        precipitation_unit='mm/h',
        weather_format='df',
        data_source='df',
        data=df,
        rename_columns=rename_dc,
        )

    return weather
